review:
A supercharged Splash. Three to five scatters give 10 to 20 free spins, and before they start, a fishing animation can unlock up to five modifiers: more money fish, special symbols, extra spins, or starting at level two.

In the bonus, fisherman wilds collect every fish on screen – worth up to 1,000x – and every fourth wild adds 10 spins with a 2x, 3x, then 10x multiplier. For Big Bass fans who want bigger fish. 96.52% RTP.
